usage: Refers to the cello, a string instrument in the violin family, usually played sitting down with a bow.
Common in music lessons, orchestra settings, and instrument shops; the short form "大提" is also heard in speech.
Use it as a normal noun: it can take measure words like "一把" when talking about one instrument.
Sounding quite neutral and standard; good for both formal writing and everyday conversation when talking about the instrument.
